front.title: Deterministic Networking (DetNet) Data Plane - Tagged Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (TCQF) for bounded latency with low jitter in large scale DetNets

abstract.t:
This memo specifies a forwarding method for bounded latency and bounded jitter for Deterministic Networks. It is a variant of the IEEE TSN 802.1Q(ch) Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (CQF) method, called Tagged CQF (TCQF), in which the cycle number is indicated in an existing or new packet header field, called the cycle tag. This tag allows more than two cycles to be used and replaces the cycle mapping of CQF, which is based purely on the synchronized reception clock.
Whereas CQF supports low end-to-end jitter across limited-scale networks with link speeds mostly up to 10Gbps, TCQF supports the same low end-to-end jitter across large-scale, wide-area networks with high per-hop latency and jitter (which is not possible with CQF), and enables high-speed hardware implementations above 10Gbps without requiring more accurate clock synchronization. Like CQF, TCQF eliminates the need for per-DetNet-flow state on midpoint routers, requiring only flow-agnostic cycle state. Because it is specified as a DetNet scheduling method, TCQF can be deployed not only as a sub- network method, but also as part of a DetNet forwarder.
This memo standardizes TCQF as a mechanism independent of the tagging method used. It also specifies tagging via (1) the existing MPLS packet Traffic Class (TC) field for MPLS packets, (2) the IP/IPv6 DSCP field for IP/IPv6 packets, and (3) a new TCQF Option header for IPv6 packets.
